slowdown.note: He is a cosponsor of the AI Data Center Moratorium Act (H.R. 9442, introduced 24 June 2026 by Ocasio-Cortez), a pause on new data center construction until laws are enacted that 'safeguards the public from the dangers of artificial intelligence'. The bill's findings cite expert warnings of 'catastrophic consequences' and loss of control, but its conditions for lifting the moratorium also cover jobs, electricity bills and the environment, and no words of his own tie it to risk from AI itself, so none under the rubric (same treatment as the other cosponsors in this project). Reviewer may reconsider.

pause.note: No statement found for or against a halt to frontier AI development. The data center moratorium is not counted as a pause of frontier AI. He is not among the 12 cosponsors of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538) listed by FastDemocracy.

intl.note: No statement found on coordinating with China on the pace of AI development. His 2 September 2026 Intelligence Committee questioning opposed selling H200 chips to China, which is competition with China, not coordination.
